quote: No. I I I wasn't interested in that. So I already had
stewart_read: Customer references a prior discount/offer he was chasing, but rep never asks what it was.
alternative_hypothesis: Rep may have judged this too minor to chase given short call — but the info directly informs qualification and message match.
coaching_implication: Ask 'what discount was that?' before moving to the next verify item.

stewart_read: Second disclosure of prior solar contact (design seen 6-8 months ago); rep only asks timing, not company or outcome.
alternative_hypothesis: Rep could be intentionally keeping the call short since he's already moving to bill collection — but this skips useful competitive intel per schema.
coaching_implication: Follow prior_designs with 'who was that with, and what did they show you?'

quote: I would say about 3¢ a month.
stewart_read: The bill figure is garbled in the transcript and the rep's own surprised reaction implies a much larger true number, but he never restates or confirms it clearly with the customer.
alternative_hypothesis: This could be a transcription artifact rather than a rep failure — the rep does react appropriately ('Oh my goodness'), suggesting he heard a real number even if the transcript garbled it.
coaching_implication: Always restate the bill number back verbally to lock the anchor and confirm the transcript/CRM record is accurate.

quote: Okay. Well, I'm not home right now.
stewart_read: Customer can't get the bill and the rep pivots to a next-day callback without any specific time or a locked handshake.
alternative_hypothesis: Given the customer volunteered 'tomorrow would be better,' rep may be reasonably trusting a repeat-cooperative customer — but no time was locked.
coaching_implication: Lock a specific time window (e.g., '10am tomorrow, does that work?') rather than 'tomorrow in the morning.'

quote: K. Sounds good, John. Thanks for your time today. I'll talk to you tomorrow
stewart_read: Call ends with no time block, no 'is that fair' handshake, and no text-follow-up promise — button_up is incomplete per verified events.
coaching_implication: Even a callback should get the full button-up treatment: specific time, confirm they'll be available, promise a text.
